map.k1 因子什么意思？: What does the k1 factor mean?
map.瑞利常数，反映工艺难度与照明/掩模优化水平；k1 越小分辨率越高，但受分辨率增强: Rayleigh constant, reflecting process difficulty and lighting/mask optimization level; smaller k1 means higher resolution, but constrained by resolution-enhancement techniques (OPC, phase shift) and physical limits.
map.焦深为什么重要？: Why is depth of focus important?
map.DOF 是清晰成像的轴向容差；DOF 小则 wafer 平整度/调焦要求更严，直: DOF is the axial tolerance for clear imaging; a small DOF tightens wafer flatness/focusing requirements and directly affects overlay yield; immersion and high NA compress DOF.
